correctness.rationale: In RESULT.md, all collision-free labeled jumps yield noncolliding occupation-count rates a(n-b)/n and b(m-a)/m, and cross-pair destination A/B hazards ab/m and ab/n. Constant hazard ratio n:m permits a Bernoulli mark independent of unmarked collision time, pair, and pre-collision path. First-jump conditioning yields the exact (k+1)-state Laplace system. The transient occupation generator tends to the k-particle Ehrenfest generator, with stationary mean ab=k(k-1)/4 and spectral gap 2; first-order simple eigenvalue perturbation proves the fixed-k scaled exponential limit uniformly over feasible starts. All boundaries m,n>=1,k>=2 distinct starts are retained; 399 supplementary exact-rational checks agree.
residual_risks: First jump into another walker under continuous-time, independent equally fast walks on bicliques, deterministic distinct starts; fixed k and m,n→∞ for rare collision law; not a vertexwise uniform collision-location theorem.
